_note: Declares source -> projection -> consumer for every fact stored more than once.
Read by seneschal/scripts/check_context_stores.py (its docstring is the design record).
This file declares ONLY pairs that ALREADY EXIST in the tree. It does not propose a store, migrate
one, or reserve an id for a future one: a pair nobody decided on is how a report-only checker
`model-config` and `governor` are the cockpit's hand-duplicated copies of two daemon-side tables.
The cockpit is its own dependency world and deliberately never imports the daemon's modules, so
each copy is a projection maintained by hand. Neither is GENERATED, so neither can be
regenerate-and-diffed: both are `declared-only`, and `cockpit/server/test_parity.py` is the
value-level tripwire that actually holds them together in CI.
`run-log`'s source is the local file; its projection is the active store's Run Log domain
(`store:` addresses a backend-neutral store domain, which this checker counts but never opens).
The store row is WRITTEN BY THE SAME RUN that appends the local file, not generated from it, so
there is nothing to regenerate-and-diff. `seneschal/state/` is gitignored, so CI cannot read the
source either way: this pair's venue is `dream`.
`writer: "modes"` means AN LLM TURN WRITING PROSE, not a script — exactly why that pair is
declared-only. `venue` is `ci` for tracked pairs and `dream` for runtime pairs. CI runs
`--venue ci`; nothing runs `--venue dream` yet, and the checker prints that split on every run

projections.reason: A hand-maintained duplicate of the rank/alias table (the cockpit never imports daemon code). Not generated, so there is nothing to regenerate-and-diff; cockpit/server/test_parity.py compares the two tables value-for-value in the cockpit-server CI job instead.

A hand-maintained duplicate of the governor SCHEMA and rollup (the cockpit never imports daemon code). Not generated, so there is nothing to regenerate-and-diff; cockpit/server/test_parity.py compares the two value-for-value in the cockpit-server CI job instead.

The store's Run Log row is written by the run that also appends the local file (seneschal/references/memory.md, the run-log protocol), not generated from it, so there is no renderer to re-run and nothing to regenerate-and-diff. seneschal/state/ is gitignored, so CI cannot read the local source either way. Declared-only until a renderer exists.
